events.text: For 2023, the Aboitiz Group allocated capital expenditure of almost Php 78 billion, a 10% increase from the Php 70 billion utilized in 2022.
The Aboitiz Group allocated P153 billion for capital expenditures in 2024, with AboitizPower receiving the largest share of P73 billion, focusing on renewable energy projects.

Aboitiz Equity Ventures set a P88.5 billion capital expenditure plan for 2026, focusing on energy expansion through AboitizPower, infrastructure projects, renewable energy investments, and a planned stake in Vietnam's Van Phong Power.
